system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. You gain the [Nature] tag. You gain a +1 bonus to [Speed].

(Effect): A secondary target within a range of [Target: Single / Range: 4 Sq.] from you takes [SRx7] direct damage.

(CR21): Increase the damage to [SRx10].

A special skill that makes a high-level pact with Wild Boar, an ancestor spirit that embodies the wildness of nature, and uses it. The giant boar runs around the battlefield with its momentum and crushes the enemy.
